definitions.full: H6579. partemim מַּרְתְּמִים noun masculine plural nobles (loan-word from Old Persian fratama , first , Spieg APK 232 , compare Sanskrit prathama; Lag Arm. Stud. § 2289 ); — ׳הַמּ Est 1:3 ; 6:9 ; Dan 1:3 .
